name: mobius_witch
description: a Mobius Witch (Fall from Heaven), a young sorceress: long flowing white hair, a gold circlet with a small pink gem, a tall crooked purple witch hat with a gold-trimmed brim and a pink band with a gold gem, purple-and-black robes with wide sleeves lined in pink, gold trim, a pink sash with a gold buckle, small dark shoes, a twisted dark wand tipped with a pink gem held low in her RIGHT hand, and her LEFT palm raised open under a floating golden mobius ring (a twisted figure-eight band, pink on the inside)
hands: the pink-gem wand stays in her right hand on the screen-left side and her left hand on the screen-right side is an empty open palm raised under the floating golden mobius ring

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, the witch hat tipping back, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the wand arm thrown up and out to the left with the pink-gem wand, the empty open left hand flung out to the right), the long white hair and wide sleeves flying, the golden mobius ring wobbling in the air
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent under the robe, the pink-gem wand dipping, the empty left hand still held out, the golden mobius ring drifting
flinch.2: recovering: halfway back to the ready pose, the pink-gem wand coming back down in her right hand, the left palm rising back under the golden mobius ring

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the wand arm flung up holding the pink-gem wand high, the empty left hand drooping, the golden mobius ring tumbling out of the air
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward under the robe, torso slumps forward, head and witch hat droop, the pink-gem wand lowering, the empty left hand hanging
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the wand's pink-gem tip resting on the ground at the lower-right, the empty left hand hanging, the white hair falling forward
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the pink-gem wand slips out of the hand, legs slide forward under the robe
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the purple witch hat still on her head and the long white hair spread out; the pink-gem wand lies on the ground at the lower-right; the golden mobius ring lies on the ground beside her
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the white hair, wide sleeves and robe settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, the white hair spread out, the pink-gem wand and the golden mobius ring on the ground beside her
